facts.text: The product is titled “Sofa Drip Pro - 3 Seater Sofa (Fabric, Coco Brown).”
The selected page displays the option “Coco Brown / 3 Seater.”
The sofa measures 185 cm (73 inches) wide, 90 cm (35.4 inches) deep, and 85.5 cm (33.7 inches) high.
The listed item weight is 40.1 Kg.
The sofa is upholstered in polyester fabric.
The listed material specification is “100 % Polyester Fabric.”
The sofa has an inclined-arm design.
The sofa has elevated legs with a wooden finish.
The removable cushions can also be used as arm pillows.
The seating uses 4-inch foam paired with zig-zag springs.
The elevated legs make cleaning underneath easier.
The product page describes the construction as sturdy and says it ensures long-lasting durability.
Sofa assembly is DIY (Do It Yourself).
“Sofa Drip Pro comes with a 3‑year conditional warranty.”
The product information lists a 10 days Replacement Policy.
One care instruction says to avoid water or moisture and wipe clean with a dry cloth.
Another care instruction permits a soft, dry or slightly damp cloth for dust and light spills, and describes blotting stains with a mild, non-bleach detergent solution on a damp cloth.
The care instructions say to avoid harsh chemicals, sharp objects, and prolonged direct sunlight.
